messages:
alex: FYI AsterCare invoice INV-10221 bounced twice this morning (card_declined) and third attempt hit 3DS failure. Seen 2026-03-10 09:02 UTC.
tara: ugh. any error codes from Stripe webhooks?
alex: paste from webhook:
```
evt: evt_4MzAbC
pi: pi_2Mz...xyz
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: "Do not honor"
three_d_secure: required
```
miles: Sounds like issuer requiring SCA. Customer on Enterprise monthly plan; they requested ACH during onboarding but never completed micro-deposits.
billing-bot: Retry policy engaged: immediate retry + 6h + 48h. Manual invoice created when requested.
alex: AsterCare emailed back, they'd prefer to pay by wire today. They asked for our wire instructions and a copy of a signed invoice. Also asked whether we can accept ACH (they can set up micro-deposits if we provide account verification form).
tara: Can finance issue manual invoice INV-10222 and include payment terms Net 7? Also add GL 4305.
miles: For wire, use the standard corporate account details but redact in public channels. I'll generate secure link to bank details.
payments-ops: Reminder: when accepting wire, we require payer legal name + tax id on the invoice. If they pay before invoice created, we need to record external reference and reconcile.
alex: I'll ask for tax id and remittance email. Also asking support team to pause automatic retries to not spam customer's email.
billing-bot: Automatic retries paused for customer astercare_com. Manual invoice INV-10222 created for $11,750.00 (monthly + usage).
tara: Approve a one-time waiver of $117 late fee? They had a card rotation + SCA prompt.
miles: ok to waive. Log approver tara.
payments-ops: Wire instructions link: https://vault.redwood/safe/bank-astercare-2026 (accessed by finance only). Use internal manual API to record when wire reference received.
alex: Call scheduled with AsterCare treasury at 11:30 PT to confirm wiring details.
miles: Also opening Stripe support case for 3DS fallback: stripe_case_20260310-AC. Will monitor.
alex: Customer confirmed wire sent at 11:45 PT and provided bank ref (redacted). I recorded it in vault and uploaded remittance screenshot.
payments-ops: Received bank reference ABC123XYZ. Marking INV-10222 as pending reconciliation. Once funds clear, we'll mark paid and close INV-10221 auto-retry schedule.
billing-bot: INV-10222 status: awaiting settlement.
alex: thanks team. closing thread after reconciliation.
